name: Lago Grey beach and the Grey Glacier lookout
region: Torres del Paine National Park, west
why: Over a swinging bridge to a grey beach covered in blue icebergs, with the glacier at the end of the lake.
book: Park entry online. Boat to the glacier face from Hotel Lago Grey (book ahead).
dangers: The bridge takes 6 people at a time.
Wind on the beach and the peninsula.

points.name: Pingo river hanging bridge
points.note: From the Lago Grey ranger post car park, over the bridge.

points.name: Lago Grey beach with icebergs
points.note: Grey pebbles and stranded blue ice, the glacier far up the lake.

points.name: Grey Glacier lookout on the peninsula
points.note: Up the wooded peninsula for the full glacier front.
